notes.title: 2.0 CO-OP Split Screen Mode
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch 2.0[/b][/h1]

• NEW Split Screen Mode. Play the game locally or use [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b]!

• Fixed an issue where the weapon position would not adjust to aspect ratio changes

• Bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Update v1.1.6 - Difficulty Option
notes.content:
Update v1.1.6

* Added a difficulty option in settings. This will impact ghost spawns, damage and damage taken.
* Improved weapon handling in VR. A steady "fishing" motion now prevents ghosts from dragging you with them.
* Fixes and improvements

notes.title: VR Updates for 18 Feb
notes.content:
* Added Turn Speed slider
* Added Cinematics Motion Mode to limit camera movement during cutscenes
* Fixed movement while rotating
